It registers 14 skills for brains"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"torming, planning, TDD, debugging, and code review, and keeps the `using-superpowers` bootstrap acti"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ve throughout the session."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Installation

Replace `web` with `headless` or a custom profile "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"name when installing for a different surface, then restart that surface instead."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Registers all 14 Superpowers skills on `ctx.skills`. They appear in the skill catalog and load thr"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ough the native `skill` tool. Nothing is copied into `~/.dsh/skills`.
- Adds the `using-superpowers`"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" bootstrap as the `superpowers:bootstrap` prompt section at order 50. It is present on the first req"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"uest and survives context compaction because it is part of the system prompt, not a one-off session "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"message.
- Maps Claude Code-style tool names such as `Task`, `TodoWrite`, and `Bash`/`Read`/`Write`/"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"`Edit` to their DeepSeek Harness equivalents. The mapping also notes that hooks and slash commands a"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"eepSeek Harness equivalents. The mapping also notes that hooks and slash commands are not available."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Verification"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Check that the plugin is present in the profile:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The output should contain `id: superpowers` followed by `name: dsh-superpowers`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Then start a new session and ask for a feature. The agent should explore first and respond with ques"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"tions or a design instead of writing code immediately. Its tool calls should include `skill`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Every field is optional. Override fields in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `skills` | `true` | Register the bundled skills on `ctx.skills`. |
| `bootstrap` | `true` | Regist"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"er the `using-superpowers` prompt section. |
| `toolMapping` | `true` | Append the DeepSeek Harness "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"tool mapping to the bootstrap section. |
| `order` | `50` | Place the bootstrap after the persona (0"},{"id":"p24s4","text":") and before tool guidance (100–199). |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Setting `bootstrap: false` keeps the skills discoverable but stops them from self-triggering; the mo"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"del will use them only when it decides to consult the catalog."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Overhead"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The bootstrap adds roughly 1.1k tokens (4,465 characters) to the system prompt of each request. The "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"section is static and stays within the cached prefix. It is not appended as a new chat message on ev"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ery turn. Set `bootstrap: false` to keep the skills without the fixed prompt overhead."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` or newer
